document.title: Stack flows Text using measured size
document.summary: A `Text` gets a measured layout size from the same line breaker the renderer draws, so `Stack` and `Scroll` flow it. Layout moves to the UI thread, the implicit Rect stacking moves into layout and gets documented, and the demo drops its wrapper `Rect`s.
document.why: Every line of text in a `Stack` needed a wrapper `Rect`, and sibling `Text` children of a `Rect` stacked one line apart by an undocumented rule ([#104](source:s1)).

sources.title: Stack does not lay out Text; sibling Texts in a Rect auto-stack a line apart
sources.gist: Give Text a measured height so Stack can flow it; document or remove the implicit Rect-child stacking; extend the layout harness.

sources.label: PR #118
sources.gist: Measured Text, layout on the UI thread, Rect stacking kept and documented, demo Label without its Rect.

sources.label: Orchestrator brief · Oct 26
sources.gist: Measure in layout.c with the renderer's measurement, keep or remove Rect stacking without changing the smoke golden, extend tests, simplify the demo with identical behaviour.

lookFor: The brief asked for the demo's behaviour to stay identical ([brief](source:s3)); under Fetch's "No description" the stars line now sits one line higher, because `Label` no longer reserves two lines.

The brief scoped `instance_tree.*` to Text bounds ([brief](source:s3)); this PR also moves `layout_tree` out of `instance_tree_swap` onto the first UI-thread reader, because the glyph cache is not safe to use from the JS thread.

groups.title: One line breaker for layout and render
groups.why: Layout must size a Text with the measurement the renderer draws with ([brief](source:s3)), so the breaker leaves `render.c`.
groups.summary: `text_lines()` in `text.c` takes over the joining, wrapping and widths that `render.c` built per frame, and `render_text_instance` now draws its result at `inst->layout`.
lookFor: Subtle: `text_lines()` returns one static `TextLines`, overwritten by the next call; both callers, `own_bounds` and `render_text_instance`, read it before calling again.
`render_children` no longer counts `text_index`, so render draws every Text at `layout.y`; the per-Text line offset now comes from `layout.c`.

groups.title: Text takes its slot in a Stack
groups.why: A measured Text lets `Stack` flow it like any child ([#104](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `own_bounds` sizes a Text from `text_lines()`, `layout_flow` flows every child except raw text, and `stack_rect_texts` applies the old Rect-only line offset; the harness checks both with the Runtime Default Font that `LAYOUT_SOURCES` links in.
lookFor: A Text directly in a `Stack` or `Scroll` used to sit at its own x/y plus padding, shifted one line per earlier Text sibling; now it takes space in the flow, so the timers example's empty-log Text grows its Scroll's content height.
The Rect stacking offset is each Text's own line height times the Text siblings before it, as render computed it; the smoke golden is unchanged.

groups.title: Lay out on the UI thread
groups.why: Measuring Text rasterises through the glyph cache, which only the UI thread uses, so the JS thread can no longer run layout in `instance_tree_swap`.
groups.summary: `laid_out_front()` lays out a new front snapshot once, under `snapshot_mutex`, for the five readers of `layout`: render roots, hit test, focusables, scroll metrics and scroll-at.
lookFor: Race: `instance_exists`, `instance_is_focusable` and `instance_scroll_for_descendant` read the front snapshot without laying it out; they only read ids, types and parents, never `layout`.

groups.title: Demo Label without its wrapper Rect
groups.why: The demo was written around the missing Text layout ([brief](source:s3)).
groups.summary: `Label` in `ui.tsx` renders a bare `Text`, and each section's `lines={n}` becomes `wrap` because the Text now measures its own height.
lookFor: Every static wrapped label and blurb measures, at the Runtime Default Font, to the line count it used to reserve; Button hints and the Fetch description take their real height instead.

groups.title: Author docs for Text in Stack
groups.why: The SDK README, the `Stack` JSDoc and `CONTEXT.md` said Text was not laid out ([#104](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `CONTEXT.md` gains a **Text** entry that defines the measured size and the Rect stacking rule, and the README Layout section and `Stack` JSDoc say that Text flows.

commits.subject: feat(layout): Stack flows Text using measured size
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A Text is now as wide as its widest line (or its width) and one lineHeight per line tall, measured by the same line breaker the renderer draws from, now text_lines in text.c. Layout runs on the first UI-thread read of a swapped snapshot, since the glyph cache belongs to the UI thread. The implicit stacking of sibling Texts in a Rect moves from render.c into layout.c and is documented; the smoke app relies on it.

Fixes #104

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
